asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to BIT Strategy Limited. Are you looking for a profitable earning strategy? With the growing popularity of online investments throughout the world, we invite you to join out team. BIT Strategy Limited is a quite young and promising company on the cryptocurrency market which was registered on 2016. We're looking for integrated solutions for successful investments in equipment and organisation of crypto mining process. Today Bitstrategy Ltd offers intuitive way of investment for everyone. Through our website bitstrategy.net we propose only two investment plans, each of which provides own terms. The first one is suitable for those who want to make 6% profit on a daily basis. Within the next 25 calendar days, your total return will be 150% with your deposit back. Choosing this strategy, you can instantly withdraw profits every day. Our second strategy is for investors who value time and prefer not spend it on daily checking the balance. We offer an investment plan with profits at the end of the period after 7 days. Choosing this type of deposit your total return will be 110% in a week. Since we are the company involved in the cryptocurrency business we accept Bitcoin as a single payment instrument. The minimum deposit is one thousandth of a bitcoin. withdrawal commissions for other hidden fees and not envisaged. Besides, we offer profitable strategy for partners. You can attract referrals as part of a 3-tier affiliate program or become part of our team and get status of official agents thereby increasing your affiliate Commission up to 10%. A special feature of our offer is certainly a possibility of ushering in an international payment card, which you can use for instant making deposits and withdrawal of profit. Find out more on our website. Become a client of leader in the field of Financial Management and select the best investment strategy with BitStrategy Limited. Thank you for watching!

textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the company, investment plans, returns or payment process are genuine, available, or successful.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the stated return is guaranteed, paid, or subject to additional conditions.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitStrategy investment plans that claim fixed returns of 6% daily and other rapid profits in exchange for Bitcoin deposits. It directs viewers to register through its website and encourages referral recruitment and tiered affiliate earnings, linking the profit claims to audience participation and money transfers.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video's central offer is participation in cryptocurrency investment plans tied to emphasized fixed returns, including 6% daily profit and 110% after seven days. The affiliate program is a separate supported recruitment mechanism and is secondary.
